title: DeviceUpserted
description: A device was registered or came back after removal, or its push token changed or was cleared (signing out clears it). `side` is the side its app signed in to: a push for one side goes only to that side's devices; a device without it, not signed in since sides were kept, hears every side.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

push_token.description: FCM registration token; null when the device can no longer be pushed.

side.title: MembershipSide
side.description: A side of the market: `shipper`, `carrier`, or `platform` for GoWay's own staff.
